mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC >0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceed 4.5%, signaling aggressive rate hikes, market anticipates prolonged high rates, triggering short-term sell-offs and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or t-test p-value >0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (tightening) and decline in UNRATE (higher unemployment) creates dual pressure on growth expectations, amplifying bearish sentiment and driving negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market weakening
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS-UNRATE interaction <0.03 over 1-year window, or returns not significantly negative when both proxies move as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion where GDPC1 growth is decelerating, investors anticipate peak demand, leading to profit-taking and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive during late-cycle demand periods when GDPC1 growth is decelerating, or t-test p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained unemployment below 6% (UNRATE <6%) signals tight labor market, boosting consumer spending but also inflationary pressures, causing market uncertainty and negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when UNRATE <6%, or t-test p-value >0.05 in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When supply growth (INDPRO) exceeds 100 (2017=100), indicating robust production, it may signal overheating or weak demand, leading to market overvaluation and negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when INDPRO >100, or t-test p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent FEDFUNDS below 1% indicates monetary easing, lowering long-term rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when FEDFUNDS <1%, or Rank IC >0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE ↑) combined with declining housing starts (HOUST ↓) signals labor market weakness and weak demand, creating a dual recessionary signal that drives negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE-HOUST interaction <0.03 over 1-year window, or returns not significantly negative when both proxies move as hypothesized.
